conditions: Sophia explicitly publishes Business Law / BUSI1050 / SOPH-0032 for the WGU Business Environment Applications I receiving requirement. Its page uses singular Structure; this reviewed row is specific to that named requirement, not a general rule for matching similar course titles.
The provider page does not identify the applicable WGU catalog. Obtain WGU adviser confirmation for Business Management catalog 202605 and your intended start date before purchase.

Sophia describes three source semester credits. The retained WGU 202605 requirement is D078 with two competency units. The quantities are kept separate; the provider wording does not establish a three-CU WGU award.

Sophia warns that WGU articulations changed after March 2026 and degree-specific acceptance must be checked on the WGU Transfer Pathways site. This is a conditional provider-published candidate, not an individual university approval.
Complete transfer coursework and have official transcripts evaluated before beginning the WGU program.

appendUnresolved: The Sophia Business Law alternative reviewed on 2026-11-15 is limited to D078 in the retained Business Management 202605 ledger. The provider does not state its applicable catalog; three source semester credits do not establish three receiving competency units. Obtain WGU confirmation before enrollment.
